scripts.build: bun run pack-wasm && bun build pkg/minwgsl.js --outdir dist --minify && bun run copy-files
scripts.extract: bun run build && wasm2wat pkg/minwgsl_bg.wasm -o pkg/.wat
scripts.pack-wasm: cargo build -r && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/minwgsl.wasm --out-dir pkg --target web && bun run opt
